# ZERO-G BALL SPORTSBOOK [italic]Licensed for play in all colonies where it has not yet been banned.[/italic]
Live from the Outer Rim leagues, a new event every few minutes: the 100 metre dash, three rounds in the ring, six innings of baseball and the zero-g ball cage. Every sport has its own tab: watch it here as it happens. Stakes come straight out of your colony account when you log in with your ID card; winnings go straight back in. Gamble responsibly. The house always wins eventually.
Fans of the Gateway Comets can follow the team at [netlink="spinokafor.zg" link="spinokafor.zg"].
